description: Representative seed dataset of microgravity combustion test runs grounded in real NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) investigations. Input parameters and output magnitudes are physically plausible and internally consistent with skills/01-flame-physics-rules.md. DOI/URL links point at the real investigation families; exact per-run DOIs must be verified against psi.nasa.gov before final submission.

records.summary: The Saffire-1 experiments was performed on the Orbital Science’s Cygnus resupply vehicle after it deberthed from the ISS.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION/DETECTION: Spacecraft Fire, Smoke Distribution — real large-scale SIBAL Fabric burn at 21.6% O2, 20 cm/s concurrent flow.
records.earth_spinoff_application: fire safety and prevention efforts on Earth, including inside mines, airplanes, or submarines.

records.summary: The Saffire-1 experiments was performed on the Orbital Science’s Cygnus resupply vehicle after it deberthed from the ISS.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION/DETECTION: Spacecraft Fire, Smoke Distribution — real large-scale SIBAL Fabric burn at 21.5% O2, 20 cm/s opposed flow.
records.earth_spinoff_application: fire safety and prevention efforts on Earth, including inside mines, airplanes, or submarines.

records.summary: Flat PMMA (acrylic) sample burned in concurrent forced flow to map flame spread vs. air velocity in microgravity.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: concurrent airflow accelerates acrylic flame spread even at normal O2 — limit cabin draft near polymer surfaces.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Informs ventilation limits in aircraft cargo bays to slow polymer fire growth.

records.summary: Cotton-fiberglass fabric spread test at reduced oxygen to locate the low-O2 quenching boundary.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: weak low-O2 flames spread slowly and dimly — radiometric sensing beats visible-light detection.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Guides smoldering-fire early-warning thresholds for building smoke alarms.

records.investigation_name: Burning and Suppression of Solids II (BASS-II)
records.summary: Thick PMMA rod ignited in quiescent microgravity; vapor-bubble ejection and near-spherical flame observed.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: even in still air, melting acrylic ejects burning droplets that can spread fire to adjacent surfaces.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Explains molten-drip fire spread for plastics flammability standards (UL 94).

records.investigation_name: Burning and Suppression of Solids II (BASS-II)
records.summary: PMMA burned at elevated 30% oxygen with moderate concurrent flow; strong sooting and faster spread.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: 30% O2 (exploration-atmosphere range) nearly doubles acrylic spread rate vs. 21% — screen cabin polymers at mission O2.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Oxygen-enriched medical/industrial environments: material selection for O2 therapy rooms.

records.investigation_name: Burning and Suppression of Solids II (BASS-II)
records.summary: Cotton fabric at reduced cabin pressure (10.2 psi) with concurrent flow, simulating exploration atmosphere.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: reduced pressure partly offsets higher O2%, but concurrent flow still drives spread — cap ventilation velocity.
records.earth_spinoff_application: High-altitude aircraft cabin fire modeling at reduced pressure.

records.summary: Nine material coupons (incl. PMMA, Nomex, cotton) screened at elevated oxygen to rank flammability.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: direct material-ranking data at 34% O2 — the core use case for cabin material down-selection.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Standardized material flammability ranking for oxygen-enriched industrial settings.

records.summary: Repeat large-scale cotton-fiberglass burn at higher flow to study flow-driven growth and post-fire products.
records.safety_control_insight: SUPPRESSION: near blow-off velocity, very high flow begins to thin and extend the flame toward liftoff.
records.earth_spinoff_application: High-flow duct fire behavior for HVAC and tunnel ventilation safety.

records.summary: Isolated heptane droplet burned in quiescent microgravity; classic d2-law regression and cool-flame second stage.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: discovered 'cool flames' that keep reacting invisibly after visible extinction — a hidden re-ignition hazard.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Low-temperature cool-flame chemistry informs cleaner HCCI engine combustion.

records.summary: Heptane droplet with CO2-diluted atmosphere near the low-O2 extinction limit to map suppression effectiveness.
records.safety_control_insight: SUPPRESSION: CO2 reaches droplet extinction at markedly higher O2 than N2 — strong per-mole inerting agent.
records.earth_spinoff_application: CO2 total-flooding fire suppression design for server rooms and engine compartments.

records.summary: Heptane droplet in helium-diluted high-oxygen atmosphere; hot compact flame, soot suppressed by He transport.
records.safety_control_insight: SUPPRESSION: helium's high conductivity shrinks the flame but requires higher O2 for extinction than CO2.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Heat-transport-based suppression modeling for specialized inert-gas systems.

records.summary: Smoldering overheated wire insulation (Kapton) and other materials characterized for smoke particle size distribution in microgravity.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: microgravity smoke particles grow larger (coagulation without buoyant clearing) — tune detectors for bigger particles.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Improved smoke-detector particle-size calibration for aircraft and cleanrooms.

records.summary: Re-flight extending SAME particle-size and moisture dependence data for ISS smoke detector requirements.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: established ISS smoke-detector particle-size thresholds; basis for next-gen multi-wavelength detectors.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Directly fed into commercial aircraft and spacecraft photoelectric smoke detector design.

records.investigation_name: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test 2 (DAFT-2)
records.summary: Compared inert dust aerosols against combustion smoke using the same detector hardware to reduce false alarms.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: dust and smoke overlap in optical scattering — key dataset for separating false (dust) from true (fire) alarms.
records.earth_spinoff_application: False-alarm rejection algorithms for industrial and residential smoke alarms; lunar-dust alarm issue (Artemis).

records.summary: Gaseous methane fed through a porous spherical burner to emulate a solid fuel surface; steady spherical diffusion flame.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: establishes the clean baseline blue spherical diffusion flame — the reference all solid-fuel emulation is compared to.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Burner calibration standard for emissions and flammability-limit testing.

records.summary: Propane in high-oxygen (85%) low-pressure mixture produced a sustained near-invisible cool flame.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: high-O2 low-pressure flames burn hot but emit little visible light — standard cameras/eyes miss them; radiometric/UV needed.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Directly relevant to high-O2 spacesuit and habitat detector requirements; cool-flame engine research.

records.summary: Reduced oxygen (70%) variant mapping the transition between hot and cool flame regimes at low pressure.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: confirms the invisible-flame hazard persists across a broad high-O2 / low-pressure window.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Bounds optical-vs-radiometric detector trade studies for enriched-oxygen environments.

records.investigation_name: Electric Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames (ACME/E-FIELD)
records.summary: Applied electric field drives ionic wind to distort a microgravity flame, emulating partial-gravity body-force effects.
records.safety_control_insight: MODELING: ion-wind stretching is the closest existing proxy for partial-gravity flame shape — used to bound Lunar/Mars predictions.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Electric-field flame control for cleaner industrial burners.

records.summary: Gaseous flame driven to its soot smoke-point in co-flow to measure the onset of soot emission in microgravity.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: pinpoints the soot-inception boundary — below it flames are blue/invisible, above it they smoke.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Soot-emission standards for cleaner diffusion burners and reduced particulate output.

records.investigation_name: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment (SLICE)
records.summary: Co-flow gaseous jet flame studied for liftoff and reattachment behavior at varying flow in microgravity.
records.safety_control_insight: SUPPRESSION: identifies flow velocities where flames lift off and can blow out — a passive suppression lever.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Flame-holding/blow-off design for gas appliance and turbine safety.

records.investigation_name: Burning and Suppression of Solids II (BASS-II)
records.summary: Kapton-insulated wire overload heating at elevated oxygen to study insulation ignition and spread.
records.safety_control_insight: PREVENTION: wire insulation resists ignition at 21% but spreads once O2 rises to exploration levels — derate wiring at high O2.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Aircraft/EV wiring insulation flammability standards.

records.summary: Heptane droplet at 15% oxygen, near the microgravity extinction limit; slow pulsation before quench.
records.safety_control_insight: SUPPRESSION: defines the oxygen floor below which droplet flames self-extinguish in microgravity.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Oxygen-reduction (hypoxic) fire-prevention systems for archives and server rooms.

records.summary: Methane porous-burner flame at 40% oxygen and reduced pressure to emulate high-O2 exploration-atmosphere solid burning.
records.safety_control_insight: MODELING: provides a controllable high-O2 reference for predicting solid-fuel burning rates at exploration atmospheres.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Calibrates flammability prediction for oxygen-enriched process industries.

records.summary: Large heptane droplet exhibiting two-stage hot-then-cool-flame combustion at reduced pressure in microgravity.
records.safety_control_insight: DETECTION: visible flame extinguishes but invisible cool-flame reaction continues — re-ignition and CO hazard without optical signature.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Cool-flame kinetics for low-emission compression-ignition engines.

records.investigation_name: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment (SLICE)
records.summary: Co-flow jet flame at elevated oxygen and higher flow approaching lifted/attached transition.
records.safety_control_insight: SUPPRESSION: higher O2 stabilizes the flame against liftoff — enriched atmospheres make blow-off suppression less reliable.
records.earth_spinoff_application: Burner stability maps for oxygen-enriched industrial combustion.

provenance_summary.note: real_psi = conditions parsed from NASA PSI ISA-Tab/CSV; flame metrics are physics_estimate until extracted from imagery/publications. seed = plausible placeholder pending real data.
